pages.text: $(o)A shaggy giant who has made a cave in the snowy plains his own, and does not share it.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It hurls ice and drives spikes up through the ground. Spread out so one volley never hits the whole party.$(br2)Its blows are slow but brutal. Roll them; do not trade hits.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Hoarfrost Pelt$() counts for the quest book.
